notes: A LODGEMENT THE BANK WILL NEVER CREDIT CAN NOW BE PUT TO REST WITHOUT REWRITING HISTORY — the mirror of last release's stale-cheque fix. Write the money back out with your own journal, then press CLOSE VIA JOURNAL on the lodgement (Cheque & Lodgement Register, Lodgements tab) and enter that journal's code. The register checks it is posted, credits the right bank account, and matches the lodgement to the pesewa. Reconciliations you have already signed off keep the lodgement under uncredited lodgements exactly as they showed it; only reconciliations after the journal's date stop carrying it. Reversing that journal reopens the lodgement automatically, so the register never points at an entry the ledger has disowned. THE SCREENS NOW SAY WHAT TO DO. Deleting a real cheque or lodgement warns that deleting erases it from PAST reconciliations too and points to Close via journal; Reinstate warns that reinstating on top of a write-back you posted yourself puts the money back twice; the Dashboard's stale-cheque alert names both exits instead of only reinstatement; and the User Guide has a new topic, CHEQUES LODGEMENTS AND THE BANK RECONCILIATION, which you can find by searching stale, reinstate, lodgement, reconcile or b/f. TWO SILENT GAPS NOW SPEAK. A remitted cheque that never reached the register at all — a run interrupted at exactly the wrong moment — is now named on the checks banner with what to do about it, and the Inventory screen carries the same stock-account-versus-register agreement check the Fuel screen has, including saying so when it cannot check. THIS RELEASE CARRIES A DATABASE CHANGE that applies itself on first launch. Back up before installing: Backup & Export, Back up now.
